third_party_evaluations.summary: LPI's expert Linux security certification (303-300); requires active LPIC-2.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced expert: 2, professional: 1. The ordered median is expert. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Recorded senior rigor, active LPIC-2 dependency and advanced vendor-neutral Linux security support expert domain responsibility at five years; the evidence does not describe practical testing or wider enterprise leadership.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded accreditation, senior Linux security scope and the active LPIC-2 prerequisite support expert platform depth. The five-year profile and unspecified practical format mean hands-on capability should still be validated separately.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded active LPIC-2 prerequisite, five-year profile and senior Linux-security scope support professional knowledge. An unspecified proctored exam does not provide enough applied evidence for the expert source hint.
